title: Pack up!
objectives: synthesize prepositions of place and there is/are in packing tasks

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Pack up!.
Welcome to today's lesson: Pack up!! Today we will practice how to synthesize prepositions of place and there is/are in packing tasks.

elements.content: synthesize prepositions of place and there is/are in packing tasks; describe room arrangements

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: house, flat, bag, wardrobe, table, chair

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Where is the bag in the text?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Pack up your bag! Put the phone on the table and the keys inside your bag.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
We need to pack up. There is a bag under the table. Put the keys in the bag and chairs near the wardrobe.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Give instructions on where to pack items when moving or cleaning a room.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: synthesize prepositions of place and there is/are in packing tasks, describe room arrangements.
